name: Potion of Mind Reading

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Detect Thoughts (save DC 13) for 10 minutes, no Concentration.
text: A pinkish, egg-shaped cloud hangs in this dense purple liquid. Drinking it lets you read minds as with Detect Thoughts (save DC 13), and the effect lasts 10 minutes without Concentration.
